description.value:
Whenever you deal Sneak Attack damage, you can give up two of those dice to perform a dark art instead. The save DC for these is 8 plus your proficiency bonus plus your Intelligence modifier.

Envenomed Art. The target attempts a Constitution save or is poisoned until the end of your next turn.

Hallucinatory Art. The target attempts a Wisdom save or is blinded until the end of your next turn.

Vanishing Art. The target attempts a Dexterity save. On a failure, you can move up to 10 feet without provoking an opportunity attack from it.
